subject: The one mistake 90% of users make with the AI therapist
preview_text: I discovered a secret that makes the AI 10x more helpful. It's not what you think, and most people skip it.
body_paragraphs: When I was building the AI therapist, I made a huge assumption. I thought people would just pour their hearts out. But the data showed something different—most users were asking surface-level questions and missing the real magic.

Here's the confession: the AI isn't a magic 8-ball. It's a mirror. The more specific and raw you get—like telling it exactly what your ex said, or describing the physical ache in your chest—the more it can reflect back patterns you can't see. It's trained on thousands of real breakup stories, not just generic advice. This transforms it from a chatbot into a true insight engine.

That's why the 'Emergency Mode' for 3AM spirals has a hidden layer. When you tap it, don't just say 'I'm sad.' Tell it the obsessive thought loop verbatim. Describe the memory that won't leave. The AI cross-references your unique pain points with proven coping strategies and gives you a lifeline that actually fits.

Open the app right now and go to the AI therapist. This time, lead with the gritty, ugly truth. Just one sentence of raw honesty. See what it reflects back. P.S. The users who do this report their 'aha' moments happen 3x faster. This is the hack that changes everything.
